text:
Bloom Cafe · Thursday, September 24

Thursday was a steady day: $516.85, about the same as a typical Thursday; nothing unusual came up this week.

• Top sellers: Latte (16 sold); then Cold Brew (15 sold); then Americano, Butter Croissant and Pumpkin Spice Latte (12 each)
• Busiest hour: 8am
• Alerts: none in the past week
